title: PytestSeleniumRcaResult
description: Structured output of pytest-selenium-failure-analysis when invoked programmatically (e.g. by pytest-failure-triage Step 4). Mirrors the human-facing template in assets/failure-analysis-template.md but adds the queue routing field needed by triage Step 5 and agentic-sdet-governance authorization tiering. Schema is forward-compatible: new optional fields may appear; consumers MUST ignore unknown fields.

nodeid.description: Echoed from the input failures.json entry — required for ticket grouping and audit.

failure_summary.description: One-paragraph plain-language summary. Matches the Failure Summary section of assets/failure-analysis-template.md.

classification.description: One of the categories defined in references/failure-taxonomy.md. snake_case in JSON; human-facing template uses Title Case.

confidence.description: Low: significant missing evidence or multiple plausible causes. Medium: one likely cause with caveats. High: cause is reproducible from the evidence at hand.

queue.description: Routing decision used by pytest-failure-triage Step 5 (ticket grouping) and agentic-sdet-governance (authorization tier). Autonomous = safe to hand off to pytest-selenium-test-improvement then re-run-gate. Needs owner = requires human SDET review before any change. Ignored = test/run noise (e.g. cascade after a fixed root failure).

evidence.description: Specific log lines, file paths, screenshot references, or git commits that justify the classification.

next_step.description: Smallest concrete action: collect more evidence, file a bug, or hand off to a downstream skill.

not_recommended.description: Tempting-but-unsafe fixes (skips, sleeps, broad retries) that this skill explicitly refuses to recommend. Surfaced to humans so they don't independently re-invent the bad fix.

missing_evidence.description: Evidence that would have raised confidence but was not available. Fed back to pytest-failure-triage for the final report's WARNING section.

handoff.description: Optional explicit hand-off pointer. When present, supersedes free-text suggestions in recommended_next_step.
